UI_ViewpointFixes_Description: Unofficial fixes for Project Viewpoint. Untick a fix to get Viewpoint's own behaviour back.
UI_ViewpointFixes_Debug_Tooltip: Writes extra [ViewpointFixes] lines to console.txt, for bug reports.
UI_ViewpointFixes_VPF002: VPF-002: Pick up / place / rotate cursor
UI_ViewpointFixes_VPF002_Tooltip: Makes the furniture pick up, place and rotate cursor work in first and third person. Its choices appear in Viewpoint's interaction menu; where there's no menu, the take key (F) accepts.
